thread:
Aisha Kapoor: Shared a refreshed draft for the product launch post, link: https://drive.redwood/marketing/launch-v9
Darren Liu: Reading now. Two quick things I saw: bench section needs a callout on dataset + run date, and we should standardize CTAs for the blog vs. webinar flow.
Priya S: Agreed on dataset callout. Suggest: "Benchmarks run on internal docs-search workload (2026-03-18); results shown vs. open baseline."
Aisha Kapoor: Good wording. Priya, can you paste the exact sentence you'd like in the hero subline? trying to keep hero tight.
Priya S: Hero subline suggestion: "Real-world docs-search tests (2026-03-18) show up to 48% lower per-query cost with continuous caching enabled."
Darren Liu: Love that. Marco, any issues with that stat from the bench team?
Marco G: It's accurate for the docs-search workload with mosaic-13b quantized profile. We should add an asterisk linking to the full methods section: "*See methods for batch sizes, models, and hardware."
Aisha Kapoor: Noted. Next: CTAs. We want a primary CTA for the hero and a secondary for the bench section. Primary should send to webinar signup, secondary to full benchmark repo.
Priya S: For UTMs, ops prefers this pattern: campaign=prod-launch-q2, source=blog, medium=organic, term=bench|webinar. Example:
```
?utm_campaign=prod-launch-q2&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_term=hero-webinar
```
Marco G: Also confirm inbound routing: webinar registrants first go to SDR-EMEA queue (72h), then to SDR-global. OpsBot, can you validate the webhook mapping to HubSpot/segment?
OpsBot: webhook mapping check: OK. Required fields present: email, first_name, utm_campaign, utm_term, region_hint. Routing rule note: use region_hint=="EMEA" OR timezone offset when region missing.
Darren Liu: Tiny copy tweak: hero CTA copy should be "View benchmarks & register" (keeps promise clear). Don't use "Try now" for gated content.
Aisha Kapoor: Done. Image alt text: please add descriptive alt for the hero chart: "Latency vs cost chart for mosaic-13b on docs-search workload".
Priya S: Legal note: replace any instance of "proven" with "validated in our tests" per compliance.
Aisha Kapoor: I'll run the replacement and push a new draft link in a bit.
Marco G: Timeline: final signoff by 5pm PT, then staging publish scheduled for 10pm PT. Ops will enable staging webhook at 9:45pm.
Darren Liu: I'll finish the UTM matrix and drop the CSV to the ops channel by 4pm PT.
Aisha Kapoor: Thanks everyone. Please review the updated draft once I paste the new link. Leaving thread open for final signoffs and any last-minute image/alt or accessibility checks.
